learnings: The current specmatic npm package exposes native REST test and HTTP stub APIs, but does not export Kafka mock helpers. The Kafka dependency remains declared in specmatic.yaml; executable Kafka mock verification requires an Enterprise-capable runtime mode.

Full resiliency produces WIP-tagged negative GET /orders cases for a contract operation that declares only 200. The Jest adapter preserves those WIP results and fails only on non-WIP contract failures, matching Specmatic's WIP behavior.
